selected.reason: Outstanding individual Salah goal in drawn meeting with ultimate title rivals.
Salah hat-trick and record-scale away rivalry victory.
Largest away derby winning margin since 1982.
Six wins from six in Champions League group stage, first English club to achieve it.
Two-goal deficit overturned with late Minamino equaliser on trophy-winning route.
Jota double settles semi-final and earns Wembley place.
Record ninth League Cup won after 21 successful penalties and Kepa miss.
Ninth consecutive league win reduces title deficit to one point.
Two recoveries preserve one-point title-race gap in direct confrontation.
Three-goal first half earns FA Cup final and keeps four-trophy challenge alive.
Two-goal lead lost on aggregate then three-goal second-half comeback reaches European final.
Dropped home points give City renewed margin late in title race.
Tsimikas winning penalty completes domestic cup double.
Final-day victory leaves Liverpool on 92 points, one short of City.
European final defeat ends season with two cups; match and crowd-safety chronology require care.

omissions: Inter and Benfica ties belong as verified route context within later European reports; no need to commission every knockout leg.
The 4–0 home United win may be recorded as later context to Old Trafford 5–0; the season double alone does not require repetitive second coverage.
Early routine domestic cup wins omitted. Southampton and Villa late league wins are context for final-day title situation.
Leicester league defeat and Chelsea 2–2 are relevant winter context to the March recovery; their significance does not require separate reports here.
limitations: Paris 2022: crowd safety must not repeat initially issued blame of supporters as established fact; retrieve the subsequent independent review and clearly date later findings.
Two goalless Chelsea finals have different shoot-out scores and dates; keep identities separate.
May 7 draw briefly put Liverpool top on goal difference before City next played; do not describe immediate three-point deficit without dating subsequent result.
No canonical opposition gaps in these selections.
